author: cens0r3d
install_msg: fakemessage loaded. `/fakemessage service:<discord|whatsapp|telegram|instagram|snapchat|x|facebook|reddit|twitch|kick> message:... [image]` or `[p]fakemessage <service> <text>` with an optional attachment. Run `[p]slash enablecog fakemessage` and then `[p]slash sync` to publish the slash command. The bot needs Attach Files, the host needs Pillow (`[p]pipinstall pillow`).
name: fakemessage
description: One command, ten looks: renders a message as a screenshot of Discord, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Snapchat, X, Facebook, Reddit, Twitch chat or Kick chat, with the real avatar and role colour, an optional attached picture, the platform's own bubble and markdown, and Twemoji.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any user data. Avatars and emoji are fetched while a command runs and cached as pictures; nothing is tied to a user id.
